d: The user glows red while casting and immediately recovers up to 20% of their maximum health. This spell does not level up.
A fast, low-damage strike with no windup -- no target-shape telegraph appears before it lands, but a well-timed or predicted Dodge can still avoid it.

A heavy, telegraphed strike -- a visible windup gives the target a real chance to Dodge before it lands, in exchange for far more damage than a Quick Attack. A hit staggers the target, interrupting any attack they are winding up.
Briefly become immune to dodgeable attacks, optionally moving to an adjacent tile in the process. Has its own 4 second cooldown, so it can't be used as a safer form of movement.
Wreathe yourself in a spreading toxic cloud for as long as you can sustain it. The cloud feeds on your mana and fades the moment there is none left to give.
su: Toggles a Poison aura (range 4) around you. Drains 1 mana a second.

d: A lantern that lights the way -- carried, or set down where you stand.
su: Toggles a light: carried in Target mode, set down in Ground mode.

d: A basic single target ranged attack spell that shoots hot laser bolts from the caster's eyes, one bolt after another.

A single target ranged attack that deals no direct damage of its own, instead drenching the target in a toxic, smoldering residue -- 10 stacks of Poison and 6 stacks of Burning, left to tick on their own.
su: Inflicts 10 stacks of Poison and 6 stacks of Burning.

d: A ball of fire gathered over three long seconds, then hurled to burst over a wide area, scorching everything caught in it and leaving it burning.
su: Slow fire burst that inflicts Burning.

d: A bolt of lightning that leaps from the caster's hand toward the aimed tile and keeps going, striking everything in its path until it runs out of range.
A fan of flame thrown out from the caster's hands, widening as it goes and scorching everything in front of them.
A line of flame raised across the aimed tile, nine tiles long, burning everything caught in it.
su: Damages and burns everything in a wall across the aim.

d: Turns the floor in a ring around the aimed tile into lava. Walls are left standing.
su: Turns a ring of floor into lava.

d: A surge of battle rage that lends every blow the user lands half again its force for ten seconds. Using it again while it lasts only renews it. Has a 30 second cooldown.
